headline: Veralto (VLTO) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Q2 Guidance And Analyst Target Lifts
summary: Veralto’s fair value estimate has shifted to about US$112.76 from about US$108.06, giving investors an updated reference point for where analysts see the stock today. Many recent research notes link these higher price targets to Q2 2026 results, refreshed guidance and steady Water Quality demand, even as some investors question how much upside is already reflected.
